description:
The Skill Development and Entrepreneurship Scheme (SDAS) aims to promote skill development and entrepreneurship among youth in India. 

The objective of SDAS is to enhance the employability of individuals by providing them with necessary skills and training. 

The scheme offers various benefits including financial assistance for skill development programs and support for setting up new enterprises. 

Eligibility for SDAS typically includes youth aged between 15 to 29 years who are seeking skill development or entrepreneurship opportunities. 

The application process involves submitting an online application through the official portal or visiting designated centers for assistance. 

The timeline for the implementation of the scheme varies based on the specific training program or entrepreneurial initiative. 

The Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship is the primary implementing authority for SDAS. 

Additional details may include partnerships with various training institutes and organizations to facilitate skill development programs.
